capabilities: Lazy-render Mermaid diagrams as they approach the viewport
Show placeholders with diagram type for off-screen diagrams
Render diagrams manually via commands or placeholder clicks
Open rendered diagrams in a zoomable fullscreen lightbox
Re-render visible diagrams after light/dark theme switches
extras: May conflict with other plugins that modify Mermaid rendering (e.g. Mermaid Next, Beauty Diagram); the README recommends using only one. On Obsidian 1.13+ the core Mermaid feature must be enabled in Settings → Editor or placeholders report that Mermaid is disabled. Works on desktop and mobile.
intentEvidence: 接管 Obsidian 内置 Mermaid 渲染器
problem: Obsidian synchronously renders every Mermaid diagram when a note opens, freezing the UI for seconds on diagram-heavy notes.

relations.evidence: 借鉴了社区插件 Beauty Diagram 和 Beautiful Mermaid Renderer 覆盖内置 mermaid 渲染器的实现思路

summary: Mermaid lazy-render plugin that defers off-screen diagram rendering so notes with many diagrams open without freezing the UI.
